lastActiveCase.name: Recovery Pack authoring and disabled-rollout readability @mobile

hosted.interpretation: Runaway per-process resident memory and host pressure precede runner shutdown. No hosted kernel OOM was captured; the final resource sample precedes shutdown by about 7.7 seconds. Executable identity and JavaScript heap usage were not recorded.

standalone.interpretation: The original, percentage-height-removal-only, and list controls reach the deliberate RSS guard and cannot complete the click. Removing only badge blur, removing both factors, and the 10-card blurred control complete. This independent application-derived 2x2 comparison isolates repeated badge backdrop layers; height changes alone do not resolve the reproduction.
limitations: Static synthetic markup with repository CSS; no Next.js, React, auth, API, media, or route prefetch.
Recovery Packs is a fragment-link action, not full application navigation.
Guard outcomes are bounded diagnostic interruptions, not kernel OOMs, functional passes, capacity results, or physical-device evidence.
The first harness attempt had a coordinator ReferenceError and is excluded from every comparison above.
